_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the RageCOOP egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: RageCOOP
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Co-op multiplayer for Grand Theft Auto V through the RageCOOP mod. Installs the chosen release of its server; Settings.xml and your resources are kept. The project is no longer developed, so its last release is the newest.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# RageCOOP: downloads the chosen release of the RageCOOP server from its
# GitHub releases. Settings.xml, resources and logs are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

repo=RAGECOOP/RAGECOOP-V
asset=RageCoop.Server-linux-x64.zip
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
[ "$(uname -m)" = x86_64 ] || fail "RageCOOP's Linux server is only built for x86-64 (amd64) CPUs, and this node is $(uname -m)."

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$want" 2>/dev/null) ||
    fail "RageCOOP has no release $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 1.5.4.7."
line=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag" | awk -v a="$asset" '$1 == a') || true
[ -n "$line" ] || fail "RageCOOP's release $tag has no Linux server."

if [ "$(cat .raptor-ragecoop 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ] && [ -x RageCoop.Server ]; then
    echo "RageCOOP $tag is already installed."
    exit 0
fi
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$build"; mkdir -p "$build/x"
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
echo "Downloading RageCOOP $tag"
# GitHub shows no checksum for these older files; gh-release checks one when it does.
gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "$asset" "$build/server.zip" || fail "The download of RageCOOP failed. Reinstall to try again."
unzip -tq "$build/server.zip" >/dev/null || fail "The download of RageCOOP is damaged. Reinstall to try again."
unzip -q "$build/server.zip" -d "$build/x"
[ -f "$build/x/RageCoop.Server" ] || fail "RageCOOP's download has no server in it."
chmod +x "$build/x/RageCoop.Server"
cp -a "$build/x/." .
echo "$tag" > .raptor-ragecoop
echo "Installed RageCOOP $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The RageCOOP release to install, such as 1.5.4.7, or latest. Players need a matching client mod.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name shown in the server list.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The most players that can be connected at once.

variables.name: Show in server list
variables.description: true lists the server publicly, false keeps it unlisted.
